instruction: I placed an order for lunch meeting with some of my coworkers in office today. I had sent out an email yesterday to them asking for individual orders, and everyone involved responded with their chosen food item and its base price. The tip was was 25% on the food cost, and delivery fee was $12. Unlike individual orders, the tip and delivery fee are to be equally shared among all, including me. Make all the necessary (public) venmo requests with a description note, "Order for Lunch Meeting".

def fetch_outbox(query):
    all_threads=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        batch=apis.gmail.show_outbox_threads(access_token=access_token, query=query, min_created_at=yesterday, max_created_at=yesterday, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        # batch is a list per schema
        print('outbox query',query,'page',page_index,'len',len(batch))
        if not batch:
            break
        all_threads.extend(batch)
        page_index+=1
        if page_index>50:
            break
    return all_threads

threads_lunch=fetch_outbox('lunch')
threads_order=fetch_outbox('order')
print('threads_lunch_count', len(threads_lunch))
print('threads_order_count', len(threads_order))
# preview
preview=lambda ts: [(t['email_thread_id'], t['subject'], t['created_at'], [(p['name'],p['email']) for p in t['participants']]) for t in ts[:3]]
print('preview_lunch', preview(threads_lunch))
print('preview_order', preview(threads_order))

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Fetch supervisor profile for venmo login username/email
profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
print('supervisor_profile', profile)

# Login to venmo
venmo_pw = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
login_resp = apis.venmo.login(username=profile['email'], password=venmo_pw)
venmo_token = login_resp['access_token']
print('venmo_login_success_keys', list(login_resp.keys()))

# Compute lunch costs from Gmail thread replies (emails + base prices)
items = [
    {'name':'Valerie Blackburn','email':'va-blac@gmail.com','base':25},
    {'name':'Patricia Ritter','email':'pa_ritter@gmail.com','base':17},
    {'name':'Nicholas Weber','email':'nicholas.weber@gmail.com','base':28},
    {'name':'Chelsea Burch','email':'chelsea-burch@gmail.com','base':21},
    {'name':'Chris Mccoy','email':'chris.mcco@gmail.com','base':15},
    {'name':'Eric Bailey','email':'eric.bailey@gmail.com','base':23},
]
food_total = sum(x['base'] for x in items)
tip_total = 0.25 * food_total
delivery_fee = 12.0
extra_total = tip_total + delivery_fee
num_coworkers = len(items)
num_people_including_me = num_coworkers + 1
extra_per_person = extra_total / num_people_including_me
print('food_total', food_total)
print('tip_total', tip_total)
print('delivery_fee', delivery_fee)
print('extra_total', extra_total)
print('num_people_including_me', num_people_including_me)
print('extra_per_person', extra_per_person)

# Determine requested amount per coworker: base + extra_per_person
for x in items:
    x['amount_unrounded'] = x['base'] + extra_per_person
    x['amount'] = round(x['amount_unrounded'] + 1e-9, 2)

print('amounts_per_coworker', [(x['name'], x['email'], x['base'], x['amount']) for x in items])

# Verify Venmo user accounts by searching for exact email match
for x in items:
    results = []
    page=0
    while True:
        batch = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_token, query=x['email'], page_index=page, page_limit=20)
        print('search', x['email'], 'page', page, 'len', len(batch))
        if not batch:
            break
        results.extend(batch)
        page += 1
        if page>50:
            break
    exact = [r for r in results if r.get('email','').lower()==x['email'].lower()]
    print('exact_match_for', x['email'], 'exact_count', len(exact), 'exact_names', [(r['first_name'], r['last_name']) for r in exact])
    x['venmo_exact_matches'] = exact

# Show criteria verification table
print('\nVERIFICATION_TABLE')
for x in items:
    print(f"{x['name']} | base={x['base']} | extra_share={extra_per_person:.6f} | request_amount={x['amount']} | venmo_exact_matches={len(x['venmo_exact_matches'])}")

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# --- Criteria enumeration gate ---
print("Task asks: 'Make all the necessary (public) venmo requests with a description note, ""Order for Lunch Meeting"".'")

criteria = [
    {
        'Criterion': 'Recipients are coworkers who replied to your lunch meeting order email yesterday',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'everyone involved responded with their chosen food item and its base price',
        'Implementation': 'Parse Gmail outbox thread(s) from yesterday with subject containing "Lunch Meeting Order" and collect reply senders + their base prices'
    },
    {
        'Criterion': 'Tip is 25% of total food base cost',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'The tip was was 25% on the food cost',
        'Implementation': 'tip_total = 0.25 * sum(base_prices)'
    },
    {
        'Criterion': 'Delivery fee is $12',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'delivery fee was $12',
        'Implementation': 'delivery_fee = 12.0'
    },
    {
        'Criterion': 'Tip + delivery are equally shared among all including you',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'Unlike individual orders, the tip and delivery fee are to be equally shared among all, including me.',
        'Implementation': 'extra_total = tip_total + delivery_fee; extra_per_person = extra_total / (num_repliers + 1); request_amount = base_price + extra_per_person'
    },
    {
        'Criterion': 'Public Venmo payment requests with description note',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'Make all the necessary (public) venmo requests with a description note, "Order for Lunch Meeting".',
        'Implementation': 'create_payment_request(description="Order for Lunch Meeting", private=False)'
    },
]

print("\nCRITERIA_TABLE")
for row in criteria:
    print(f"{row['Criterion']} | {row['Exact Quote from Task']} | {row['Implementation']}")

# --- Data extraction from Gmail thread ---
now=datetime.now()
yesterday=(now-timedelta(days=1)).date().isoformat()

# Login Gmail
gmail_pw=[p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='gmail'][0]
gmail_login=apis.gmail.login(username='susanmiller@gmail.com', password=gmail_pw)
g_access=gmail_login['access_token']

# Find outbox threads from yesterday that look like lunch ordering
threads=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
# use query keyword from subject/body
query='Lunch Meeting Order'
while True:
    batch=apis.gmail.show_outbox_threads(access_token=g_access, query=query, min_created_at=yesterday, max_created_at=yesterday, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('gmail outbox threads page',page_index,'len',len(batch))
    if not batch:
        break
    threads.extend(batch)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>50:
        break

# Fallback: also search for 'Lunch Meeting' if nothing
if not threads:
    page_index=0
    query='Lunch Meeting'
    while True:
        batch=apis.gmail.show_outbox_threads(access_token=g_access, query=query, min_created_at=yesterday, max_created_at=yesterday, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('gmail outbox threads fallback page',page_index,'len',len(batch))
        if not batch:
            break
        threads.extend(batch)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index>50:
            break

# Select the most relevant thread: prefer subject exactly 'Lunch Meeting Order'
# We'll inspect candidate threads' subject via threads list entries
print('candidate_threads', [(t['email_thread_id'], t.get('subject','')) for t in threads])

selected=None
for t in threads:
    if t.get('subject','')=='Lunch Meeting Order':
        selected=t
        break
if selected is None and threads:
    selected=threads[0]

print('selected_thread_id', selected['email_thread_id'] if selected else None)

thread=apis.gmail.show_thread(access_token=g_access, email_thread_id=selected['email_thread_id'])

# Parse each reply email body for base price.
# We assume each coworker email body like: "I would like to order ... for $X.".

import re

reply_items=[]
for e in thread['emails']:
    sender_email = e['sender']['email'].lower()
    sender_name = e['sender']['name']
    if sender_email == 'susanmiller@gmail.com':
        continue
    body=e['body']
    m=re.search(r"\$\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)", body)
    if not m:
        # no price found; skip
        continue
    base=float(m.group(1))
    reply_items.append({'name':sender_name,'email':sender_email,'base':base})

print('parsed_reply_items', reply_items)

# Resolve group sizes
food_total=sum(x['base'] for x in reply_items)
tip_total=0.25*food_total
delivery_fee=12.0
extra_total=tip_total+delivery_fee
num_coworkers=len(reply_items)
num_people_including_me=num_coworkers+1
extra_per_person=extra_total/num_people_including_me

for x in reply_items:
    x['amount_unrounded']=x['base']+extra_per_person
    x['amount']=round(x['amount_unrounded']+1e-9,2)

# --- Identity resolution via phone contacts (canonical 'who you know') ---
phone_pw=[p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='phone'][0]
phone_login=apis.phone.login(username='3296062648', password=phone_pw)
phone_token=phone_login['access_token']

# helper to search contacts exactly by full name and email

def split_first_last(name):
    parts=name.split()
    if len(parts)==1:
        return parts[0],' '
    return parts[0], ' '.join(parts[1:])

resolved=[]

for x in reply_items:
    first,last=split_first_last(x['name'])
    # post-filter search_contacts on exact first+last and email
    results=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        batch=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=x['name'], page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not batch:
            break
        results.extend(batch)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index>50:
            break
    exact=[r for r in results if r['first_name'].lower()==first.lower() and r['last_name'].lower()==last.strip().lower()]
    exact_email=[r for r in exact if (r.get('email') or '').lower()==x['email']]
    if len(exact_email)==1:
        resolved.append(x.copy())
        resolved[-1]['contact_id']=exact_email[0]['contact_id']
    else:
        print('AMBIGUITY UNRESOLVED or NO_MATCH for', x['name'], 'candidates', len(exact_email), '- EXCLUDING')

reply_items_target=resolved

print('\nGROUP_SUMMARY')
print('food_total',food_total,'tip_total',tip_total,'delivery_fee',delivery_fee,'extra_total',extra_total)
print('num_coworkers',num_coworkers,'num_people_including_me',num_people_including_me,'extra_per_person_exact',extra_per_person)

print('\nTARGET_SET')
for x in reply_items_target:
    print((x['name'], x['email'], x['base'], x['amount']))

print('target_count', len(reply_items_target))

# Login Venmo
venmo_pw=[p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_login=apis.venmo.login(username=apis.supervisor.show_profile()['email'], password=venmo_pw)
venmo_token=venmo_login['access_token']

# Verify receiver exists exactly by email (search is broad)
for x in reply_items_target:
    page_index=0
    results=[]
    while True:
        batch=apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_token, query=x['email'], page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        if not batch:
            break
        results.extend(batch)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index>50:
            break
    exact=[r for r in results if (r.get('email') or '').lower()==x['email'].lower()]
    print('venmo_exact_match', x['email'], 'count', len(exact), 'names', [(r['first_name'],r['last_name']) for r in exact])
    if len(exact)!=1:
        raise Exception('Venmo identity not uniquely resolved for '+x['email'])
    x['venmo_user_email']=exact[0]['email']

print('\nVERIFICATION_TABLE_FINAL')
for x in reply_items_target:
    print(f"To={x['venmo_user_email']} | Item={x['name']} | base={x['base']} | request_amount={x['amount']:.2f} | note=Order for Lunch Meeting")
